_comment: Advisory trigger evals for generating-ugc-videos — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Covers the four formats (review/try-on/tutorial/unboxing) plus negatives that must NOT fire: plain image gen, plain video gen, and a product video with no creator/UGC signal.

cases.query: make a UGC video of a creator reviewing our new serum
create an influencer video talking about our protein powder
generate an unboxing video for our subscription box
make a try-on video of a model wearing our jacket
create a UGC tutorial for our blender with a creator on camera
I want a talking head creator ad for our skincare brand
make an OOTD haul featuring our sneakers
create a testimonial video of someone recommending our app
make a UGC creator ad for our accounting service, no physical product
generate a video of waves crashing on a beach
create an image of a red bicycle in a city street
make a product video ad with slow motion of our sneakers
what's the weather in Tokyo today
